title: AffineOpenHigherDirectImageSectionsIso
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For an affine open $U\subset S$, a quasi-coherent module $M$ on $X$ [pqf-def-coherent], and $p\in\mathbf N$, there is an isomorphism of abelian groups $R^p\Gamma(f^{-1}U,-)(M)\cong\Gamma(U,R^p f_*M)$. The section functor and ordinary right derived functors are [def-sc-open-module-cohomology, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image].

source.place: Tag 01XK, together with Tag 01XJ (1) and Cohomology Tags 01E1, 01E4 and 01F4 (2)

proof.text: For V=f^{-1}U restrict f to V -> U and M to V. Both morphism hypotheses survive open base change, and M stays quasi-coherent. The quasi-coherence clause of Tag 01XJ shows that the higher direct images on U are quasi-coherent. This is the clause (1) argument of lem-pc-finite-support-hi, not its uniform-bound clause.

Affine vanishing kills their positive cohomology on U. Apply the Leray-edge degeneration theorem to obtain H^p(V,M|V) isomorphic to sections on U of R^p of the restricted direct image, in every degree p.

Restriction of injective resolutions computes H^p(V,M|V) as the right derived openModuleSections on X. On each open W inside U, the pushforward of this restricted resolution has sections of the original resolution over f^{-1}W. Consequently its cohomology sheaf is the restriction to U of the original R^p f_*M, by the sheafified-cohomology-presheaf description. These source and target identifications give the displayed group isomorphism; no vanishing bound or compactness of S is involved.

theorem nonempty_affineOpen_higherDirectImage_sections_iso
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (U : S.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (p : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      ((((RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).rightDerived p).obj M) ≅
        (RingedSpace.openModuleSections S.toRingedSpace U).obj
          (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj M))
